Main tasks: Handle inbound calls, assist with product questions (GSM, internet, TV), troubleshoot, register data
Contract: Interim with option for permanent, full-time (38h/week or 30h), day shifts Mon-Sun 8-20h
Language: Dutch 'zeer goed' required
Pay: Not stated, but includes meal vouchers after 3 months
jobs.why_good:
No experience or degree required – open to early-career candidates
Customer service role leverages candidate's communication skills and technical affinity
Flexible schedule and paid training provided
Located in Hasselt, commutable from Zwijndrecht (Antwerp area)
Candidate's Dutch is B1 and improving; 'zeer goed' is a stretch but no French required

jobs.details:
Role: Customer service representative (inbound calls/digital queries)
Main tasks: Answer calls, register data, handle complaints, provide support
Contract: Interim with option for permanent, full-time, day work
Language: Dutch 'vlot' required, French/English/German a plus
Pay: €2,336-€2,820/month + meal/eco cheques, transport reimbursement
jobs.why_good:
No experience required – perfect for early-career candidate
Customer service role – candidate has communication skills from logistics and digital marketing
English is a plus – candidate is professional in English
Location Mechelen – near Zwijndrecht/Antwerp
Offers training and growth – candidate can improve Dutch on the job
